concrete_capability_transition: brownie resume changes from parsed-but-unsupported CLI surface to a bounded restart-safe continuation command that reads fresh runtime task.list progress evidence and invokes existing Rust runtime headless.continue_once authority.

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Lets an interrupted CLI user continue from runtime-owned persisted progress using the official brownie resume command rather than internal JSON-RPC choreography.
Uses runtime-derived progress fingerprints and aggregate sequence as the replay-safe continuation boundary while keeping continuation selection and execution inside the Rust runtime.
Surfaces the runtime-owned continuation status and next_action in bounded human and JSON output without exposing raw runtime envelopes.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, agent_loop, and progress_visualization by adding the official CLI resume path over existing runtime continuation evidence.
answers.new_capability: A user can run brownie resume and the CLI will obtain fresh task.list progress evidence, call headless.continue_once with explicit authorization and a deterministic continuation id, then render the bounded runtime-owned result.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: CLI-4 added brownie run, while status, inspect, and list remain read-only. They cannot perform the existing runtime-owned continuation mutation, and Resume currently returns unsupported-command.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Required CLI Product DoD gap CLI-5 remains open: interrupted or lost-response CLI runs cannot be resumed through the official command, blocking the later restart/recovery golden journey.
answers.non_duplicative: CLI-2 connected status, CLI-3 added read-only inspection/list, and CLI-4 added run execution. CLI-5 performs the distinct continuation boundary through headless.continue_once.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The CLI uses existing task.list and headless.continue_once runtime methods; it does not add a runtime RPC or generic passthrough.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds executable resume behavior and bounded CLI projection, not a report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, or summary surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Runtime APIs and policy remain unchanged; user-visible CLI behavior changes because brownie resume executes the existing runtime continuation boundary instead of failing unsupported.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless and terminal users can recover from process interruption or lost response with a replay-safe deterministic continuation id bound to fresh runtime progress.
answers.milestone_progress: Closes the CLI-5 Product DoD gap and unlocks CLI-10 restart/recovery golden journey validation after later output/help/golden-journey gaps are addressed.

accepted_capability: CLI resume invokes existing Rust runtime continuation authority from fresh progress evidence.
CLI resume renders bounded human and JSON output while preserving runtime authority over replay, recovery, permissions, and workspace mutation.
behavior_evidence: Tests capture exact task.list and headless.continue_once calls.
Tests cover bounded human/JSON output, stale/no-eligible results, fail-closed transport errors, timeout class, and real runtime smoke.
safety_boundary: No Core Runtime terminal campaign state is reopened or mutated.
No runtime JSON-RPC method, protocol schema, ledger semantic, runtime permission rule, Mode Pack rule, provider rule, verifier rule, or workspace mutation authority is added.
The CLI does not inspect raw ledger files or derive recovery policy; it only passes fresh bounded progress evidence to Rust runtime continuation authority.
CLI output excludes raw prompts, provider responses, ledger payloads, file content, stdout/stderr payloads, commands, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets.
non_goals: No mode-list implementation, stable complete JSON projection overhaul, installation/package release, arbitrary-repository golden journey, or restart/recovery golden journey closure.
No generic RPC passthrough, report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, preview, or summary surface.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected adding a new resume runtime RPC because headless.continue_once already owns the continuation boundary.
Rejected reading ledger files directly in the CLI because replay and recovery semantics belong to the Rust runtime.
Rejected automatic multi-step scheduling because CLI-5 is one explicit resume step and later UX/golden-journey phases remain separate.
Rejected mixing mode-list and full public JSON semantics because CLI-6 and CLI-7 own those gaps.
technical_debt: CLI-6 must improve progress and next-action UX and resolve advertised brownie mode list.
CLI-7 must complete stable bounded public JSON projections and deterministic exit-code semantics.
CLI-10 must validate a full restart/recovery golden journey after resume exists.
next_capability_rationale: After CLI-5 lands, proceed to CLI-6 Progress and Next Action UX rather than adding another resume wrapper.
